# Sternbild marks

The approved app marks, copied unchanged from the organization repository. Use a mark exactly as it is: do not
recolour or redraw it.

| File | Source | Source commit |
|---|---|---|
| `compass-icon.svg` | `organization/public/assets/compass-icon.svg` | `33d11c9` |
| `compass-icon-minerals.svg` | `organization/public/assets/compass-icon-minerals.svg` | `74db683` |

`SHA256SUMS` holds the checksum of each file. `apps/web/scripts/sync-assets.mjs` checks it before copying.
